title: External skills manifest
description: Reviewed external skills imported into one plugin. Contributors edit this file; the publication workflow materializes plugins/<plugin>/skills/<name>.

sources.description: One entry per imported skill, unique by name.

description.description: Why this skill is imported, and what it does.

repository.description: HTTPS URL of the upstream git repository.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the skill directory containing SKILL.md. No leading slash, no '..' segments.

commit.description: Full 40-character upstream commit SHA the import is pinned to.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the upstream skill.
